The issuer exhibits extremely weak financial health, characterized by significant operating losses (-$459M) and net losses (-$640M) on revenues of $11.0B, alongside a highly leveraged balance sheet where total liabilities ($11.8B) almost entirely consume total assets ($12.2B), leaving a very thin equity cushion of $415M. While a current ratio of 1.78 and positive retained earnings of $2.0B provide some short-term liquidity, the combination of high leverage, negative profitability, and thin equity capitalization places the firm in the highly speculative, non-investment grade category with elevated default risk. 

DECISION: B-
